caption: The drawing features a rectangular section with a patterned design centered on a plain, light beige background. The pattern within the rectangle consists of a dark brown base color decorated with small geometric shapes. These shapes are primarily white with red accents and are arranged in a regular, diagonal grid. Each individual motif appears to be a triangle or wedge shape facing to the right, with additional lines and dots forming decorative elements around them. The motifs are oriented at an angle and repeated across the dark background, interspersed with small horizontal bars and groups of dots in white and brownish tones. There is handwritten text below the pattern, consisting of a signature to the right and a set of notations in pencil and colored ink along the lower edge of the paper.
title: Calico Print
